comparison.objective: Hook a wire to fish tape and pull it through a bent conduit; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Make a small hook-eye connection, manage two deformable chains, and pull hand-over-hand through a bore, versus rigid fine-tool insertion, torque, collar rotation, and testing.
comparison.success_condition: The hooked wire end must emerge at least 5 cm from the far mouth without premature tape removal or hand-feeding; candidate requires two repeatable compliant stops within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Shared small-feature alignment is generic; maintaining a deformable pulling joint through conduit tests a different ability.
